requiredFiles.description: Landing page rebuilt with Tailwind CSS
Link to complete Figma wireframes for all project screens

criteria: index.html uses Tailwind CSS utility classes for ALL styling — no separate CSS file with custom rules (Tailwind CDN or Vite setup is acceptable)
The page implements a dark mode toggle that works using Tailwind's dark: variant — a button or toggle must switch between light and dark mode visibly
figma-link.txt contains a URL to a Figma file that shows wireframes for all main project screens (at least 3 distinct screens)
The Figma wireframes include at least 3 states for interactive elements: empty state, filled/active state, and error state
The Tailwind implementation is responsive and uses responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:) rather than custom media queries
